## Testing Mode
RED

## Story DD Coverage
- DD3: LLM aggregation pass synthesizes cross-file findings; visibility trailer (distinct namespace, NOT 'DSO-Story-Merge:').
- DD4: Single ledger entry per (pr_number, sha, cycle_num) regardless of cluster count.

## Implementation Notes
Create `tests/scripts/test_dso_ci_review_aggregator.py`:

Cases:
- Given per-cluster results (3 clusters with 5 findings each total): aggregator synthesizes into a unified payload; cross-file findings (a finding referencing files in multiple clusters) are preserved/merged correctly.
- Visibility trailer namespace test: trailer is `DSO-Review-Coverage:` (or chosen distinct namespace); MUST NOT match `^DSO-Story-Merge:` (the prefix that verify-session-provenance.sh:137 greps for).
- Visibility trailer lists ALL reviewed files AND ALL skipped files with reason.
- Single-ledger-entry invariant: aggregator emits ONE cycle_ledger.append_cycle() call per aggregation, regardless of cluster count. Multiple region-split clusters \xe2\x86\x92 ONE ledger entry per (pr_number, sha, cycle_num).
- Aggregation cost test: aggregator counts as ONE LLM call against max_calls budget (NOT max_files \xc3\x97 max_calls).

Add .test-index RED marker `[test_dso_ci_review_aggregator]`.

## File Impact
| Source file | Action | Tests | Class |
|---|---|---|---|
| `tests/scripts/test_dso_ci_review_aggregator.py` | create | (this IS the test) | needs-creation |
| `.test-index` | modify | n/a | marker |

## Acceptance Criteria
- [ ] Unit tests pass (exit 0)
  Verify: TEST_CMD=\$(.claude/scripts/dso read-config commands.test) && [ -n "\$TEST_CMD" ] && \$TEST_CMD
- [ ] Test exists; RED

- [ ] Test asserts visibility trailer namespace distinct from DSO-Story-Merge
  Verify: grep -qE 'DSO-Review-Coverage|namespace.*distinct|NOT.*DSO-Story-Merge' tests/scripts/test_dso_ci_review_aggregator.py
- [ ] Test asserts single ledger entry invariant
  Verify: grep -qE 'single.ledger|one.ledger|exactly.one' tests/scripts/test_dso_ci_review_aggregator.py
- [ ] .test-index updated with RED marker
  Verify: grep '\[test_dso_ci_review_aggregator\]' \$(git rev-parse --show-toplevel)/.test-index

## Retry Budget
MAX_ATTEMPTS: 3 (sonnet); escalate.

comments.body:
AC AMENDMENTS (plan-review F1 + F4):

**F1 (post-S2 signature)**: Tests must assert that the single append_cycle call passes pr_number AND commit_sha matching the fixture (NOT just call count). Test is written against the POST-S2 signature so it fails today (RED) and passes after both S2 and T6 land.

**F4 (failure modes)**: Add RED test cases for:
- Aggregation LLM returns malformed JSON \xe2\x86\x92 expected behavior: falls back to un-aggregated per-cluster results with visibility comment 'aggregation failed; per-cluster findings posted separately'.
- .gitattributes parse failure \xe2\x86\x92 expected behavior: fail-open (all files included as reviewable; warning logged).
- Per-file schema-correction exhaustion \xe2\x86\x92 expected behavior: skip that file (do NOT abort aggregation); note 'schema-correction-exhausted: <file>' in aggregation output.

- [ ] Test asserts pr_number value in append_cycle call (not just count)
  Verify: grep -qE 'append_cycle.*pr_number|pr_number=' tests/scripts/test_dso_ci_review_aggregator.py
- [ ] Test covers all 3 failure modes
  Verify: grep -cE 'malformed.*aggreg|gitattributes.*parse|schema.*exhaust' tests/scripts/test_dso_ci_review_aggregator.py | awk '{exit ($1>=3?0:1)}'
